speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the detailed history. To better understand the severity of your symptoms, particularly the night sweats and weight loss, have you experienced any recent fevers or changes in your appetite?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential.
REQUEST TEST: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR).

Also, could you tell me if you have noticed any lumps or swelling in other areas of your body besides the supraclavicular region?

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Elevated WBC, Slightly Decreased Hemoglobin, Normal Platelets, Elevated Lactate Dehydrogenase; NORMAL READINGS for Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR). Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes observed on CT Scan.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of B-symptoms (night sweats, weight loss), elevated LDH, and massive involvement of cervical, axillary, and mediastinal lymph nodes is highly characteristic of this condition.
